Players Committee card image of [[Leia's Resistance Transport (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may ▼ a female Resistance character aboard for free.” Uploaded unchanged.
